    }

    a:focus-visible,
    button:focus-visible,
    summary:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid var(--accent);
      outline-offset: 4px;
    }

    main {
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    section {
      padding: 100px 0;
    }

    section + section {
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(31, 41, 38, .08);
    }

    .hero {
      padding: 104px 0 100px;
    }

    .hero-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns:
        minmax(0, 1.15fr)
        minmax(320px, .85fr);
      gap: 72px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .hero-grid > *,
    .section-head > *,
    .info-grid > *,
    .ticket-grid > *,
    .state-layout > *,
    .waitlist-box > *,
    .form-layout > *,
    .starter-layout > * {
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .eyebrow,
    .tag {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      max-width: 100%;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 9px 15px;
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.45;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .eyebrow {
      background: var(--soft-green);
      color: var(--brand);
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }

    .lead {
      max-width: 780px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 22px;
      line-height: 1.85;
    }

    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 38px;
    }

    .hero-facts {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 26px;
      margin-top: 60px;
    }

    .fact {
      min-width: 0;
      border-top: 1px solid #cdd4d0;
      padding-top: 20px;
    }

    .fact-label {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.5;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .fact-value {
      margin-top: 10px;
      font-size: 18px;
      line-height: 1.55;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .hero-card {
      position: relative;
      min-width: 0;
      background: var(--brand);
      color: #fff;
      border-radius: 32px;
      padding: 48px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero-card::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 250px;
      height: 250px;
      right: -90px;
      top: -80px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 50px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .06);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-card .tag {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);
      color: #fff;
    }

    .hero-card h3 {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      margin-top: 36px;
      margin-bottom: 22px;
      font-size: 34px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .hero-card p {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .88);
      margin-bottom: 0;
      line-height: 1.9;
    }

    .seat-meter {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      margin-top: 42px;
    }

    .meter-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: baseline;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .meter {
      height: 12px;
      margin-top: 16px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .16);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .meter > span {
      display: block;
      width: 90%;
      height: 100%;
      background: #efc86e;
      border-radius: inherit;
    }

    .section-head {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns:
        minmax(0, .95fr)
        minmax(280px, 1.05fr);
      gap: 72px;
      margin-bottom: 52px;
      align-items: end;
    }

    .section-head h2 {
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .section-head p {
      max-width: 720px;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      line-height: 1.85;
    }

    .card {
      min-width: 0;
      background: var(--paper);
      border: 1px solid rgba(31, 41, 38, .09);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 35px rgba(29, 49, 41, .04);
    }

    .card > :last-child {
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .evidence-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 26px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .photo-placeholder {
      min-height: 280px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 40px;
      border: 1px dashed #aebdb2;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          rgba(23, 72, 60, .05),
          rgba(216, 168, 73, .07)
        ),
        var(--paper-2);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .photo-placeholder > div {
      display: grid;
      justify-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      max-width: 420px;
    }

    .photo-placeholder strong {
      font-size: 24px;
      line-height: 1.4;
      color: var(--brand);
    }

    .photo-placeholder .note {
      display: block;
      line-height: 1.8;
    }

    .evidence {
      min-height: 280px;
      padding: 42px;
    }

    .evidence h3 {
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }

    .evidence p {
      line-height: 1.85;
    }

    .info-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 26px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .info-card {
      padding: 44px;
    }

    .info-card h3 {
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .info-card p {
      line-height: 1.9;
    }

    .info-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 0;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .info-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 138px minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 28px;
      padding: 24px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    }

    .info-row:last-child {
      border-bottom: 0;
      padding-bottom: 0;
    }

    .info-row dt {
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .info-row dd {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .agenda {
      display: grid;
      gap: 0;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .agenda-item {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 150px minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 36px;
      padding: 28px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    }

    .agenda-item:last-child {
      border-bottom: 0;
      padding-bottom: 0;
    }

    .agenda-item strong {
      display: inline-block;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .agenda-time {
      color: var(--brand);
      font-weight: 900;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .ticket-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 26px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .ticket {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      padding: 40px 34px;
    }

    .ticket.active {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(23, 72, 60, .18);
      border-color: var(--brand);
    }

    .ticket.sold-out {
      background: #f2f0ec;
    }

    .ticket .tag {
      align-self: flex-start;
      background: var(--soft-yellow);
      color: #6d4a10;
    }

    .ticket h3 {
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .ticket-price {
      margin: 34px 0 12px;
      font-size: clamp(34px, 3.5vw, 42px);
      line-height: 1.2;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -.035em;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .ticket-meta {
      display: grid;
      gap: 14px;
      margin: 34px 0;
      padding: 26px 0;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.75;
    }

    .ticket-meta strong {
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .ticket-actions {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: auto;
    }

    .ticket-actions button {
      width: 100%;
    }

    .state-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns:
        minmax(0, .92fr)
        minmax(0, 1.08fr);
      gap: 26px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .status-panel,
    .simulation-panel {
      padding: 44px;
    }

    .status-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 9px 16px;
      background: var(--soft-yellow);
      color: #67460f;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .status-badge.success {
      background: var(--soft-green);
      color: var(--success);
    }

    .status-badge.danger {
      background: var(--soft-red);
      color: var(--danger);
    }

    .steps {
      display: grid;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 36px;
    }

    .step {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 44px minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 18px;
      align-items: flex-start;
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: var(--paper-2);
    }

    .step-no {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #e6eae7;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .step.current {
      background: var(--soft-green);
    }

    .step.current .step-no {
      background: var(--brand);
      color: #fff;
    }

    .step strong {
      display: inline-block;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .controls {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .controls button {
      flex: 1 1 210px;
    }

    .notification {
      padding: 24px 28px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: var(--paper-2);
      border-left: 5px solid var(--brand);
      margin-top: 30px;
      line-height: 1.85;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .notification strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .rule-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 26px;
    }

    .rule-card {
      padding: 42px;
    }

    .rule-card p {
      line-height: 1.9;
    }

    .waitlist-box {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns:
        minmax(0, .9fr)
        minmax(0, 1.1fr);
      gap: 26px;
      margin-top: 28px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .queue,
    .waitlist-form {
      padding: 42px;
    }

    .queue-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .queue-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 18px;
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: var(--paper-2);
    }

    .queue-rank {
      min-width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--brand);
      color: #fff;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .notification-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .notification-card {
      padding: 38px;
    }

    .notification-card p {
      line-height: 1.9;
    }

    .form-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns:
        minmax(0, 1.1fr)
        minmax(0, .9fr);
      gap: 26px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    form.card,
    .summary-card {
      padding: 44px;
    }

    .fields {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 28px 24px;
    }

    .field {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .field.full {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
    }

    label,
    legend {
      font-size: 18px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    input,
    select,
    textarea {
      width: 100%;
      min-width: 0;
      min-height: 58px;
      border: 1px solid #bcc6c1;
      border-radius: 13px;
      background: #fff;
      color: var(--ink);
      padding: 14px 16px;
      outline: none;
      font-size: 18px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    input::placeholder,
    textarea::placeholder {
      color: #68746e;
      opacity: 1;
    }

    textarea {
      min-height: 160px;
      resize: vertical;
    }

    input:focus,
    select:focus,
    textarea:focus {
      border-color: var(--brand);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(23, 72, 60, .10);
    }

    .check-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
      align-items: start;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .check-row input {
      width: 22px;
      min-height: 22px;
      margin: 6px 0 0;
      accent-color: var(--brand);
    }

    .check-row .note {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 6px;
    }

    .validation {
      min-height: 28px;
      margin: 18px 0 12px;
      color: var(--danger);
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .summary-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 22px;
      margin-top: 34px;
    }

    .summary-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: baseline;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px 20px;
      padding-bottom: 22px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    }

    .summary-row span:first-child {
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .summary-row strong {
      text-align: right;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .data-section {
      background: #ebe8e1;
    }

    .data-section h3 {
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .table-wrap {
      overflow-x: auto;
      max-width: 100%;
      border-radius: 20px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(31, 41, 38, .10);
      background: #fff;
      margin-top: 24px;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(29, 49, 41, .035);
    }

    table {
      width: 100%;
      min-width: 850px;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.8;
    }

    th,
    td {
      padding: 24px 22px;
      text-align: left;
      vertical-align: top;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    th {
      background: #f1f3f0;
      color: #37433e;
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
      background: #fafbf8;
    }

    tr:last-child td {
      border-bottom: 0;
    }

    details {
      background: #fff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(31, 41, 38, .09);
      border-radius: 18px;
      margin-top: 20px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    summary {
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 26px 32px;
      font-size: 19px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    details > div {
      padding: 0 32px 32px;
      line-height: 1.9;
    }

    .log {
      max-height: 440px;
      overflow: auto;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 30px 0 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .log li {
      padding: 22px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .log li:last-child {
      border-bottom: 0;
    }

    .log li strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .log-time {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 8px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    .danger-zone {
      padding: 38px;
      background: #fff7f4;
      border: 1px solid #e5c7bf;
      border-radius: 20px;
      margin-top: 42px;
    }

    .danger-zone p {
      max-width: 900px;
      line-height: 1.85;
    }

    .footer {
      padding: 64px 0 84px;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
      gap: 36px;
      align-items: end;
    }

    .footer strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      font-size: 20px;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .footer .note {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .sr-only {
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      padding: 0;
      margin: -1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
      white-space: nowrap;
      border: 0;
    }

    .starter {
      padding: 88px 0;
      background: #e7ebe3;
    }

    .starter h2 {
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      font-size: 40px;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .starter-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns:
        minmax(0, 1fr)
        minmax(0, 1.15fr);
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    .starter-form,
    .starter-preview {
      padding: 42px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #fffdf8;
      border: 1px solid #c8d0c8;
    }

    .starter-form {
      display: grid;
      align-content: start;
      gap: 26px;
    }

    .starter-form label {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .starter-preview {
      background: #17483c;
      color: #fff;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .starter-preview h3 {
      margin: 24px 0;
      font-size: 40px;
      line-height: 1.35;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .starter-preview p {
      font-size: 20px;
      line-height: 1.8;
      color: #f1eee3;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .starter-preview small {
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.5;
      color: #d7ddd6;
    }

    .starter-preview hr {
      width: 100%;
      border: 0;
      border-top: 1px solid #668276;
      margin: 24px 0;
    }

    .starter input {
      width: 100%;
      min-width: 0;
      min-height: 58px;
      font-size: 18px;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      border: 1px solid #9dac9e;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .starter label {
      font-size: 18px;
    }

    [hidden] {
      display: none !important;
    }

    @media (min-width: 901px) {
      .card,
      .hero-card,
      .photo-placeholder {
        height: 100%;
      }

      .info-grid + .card,
      .info-grid[style],
      .waitlist-box,
      .data-section .card[style] {
        height: auto;
      }

      .ticket .ticket-actions {
        padding-top: 8px;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 1100px) and (min-width: 901px) {
      .hero-grid {
        gap: 44px;
      }

      .hero-card {
        padding: 36px;
      }

      .section-head {
        gap: 44px;
      }

      .ticket {
        padding: 32px 26px;
      }

      .ticket-price {
        font-size: 35px;
      }

      .info-card,
      .status-panel,
      .simulation-panel,
      .rule-card,
      .queue,
      .waitlist-form,
      form.card,
      .summary-card {
        padding: 34px;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .wrap {
        width: min(calc(100% - 48px), var(--max));
      }

      .nav-links a:not(.button) {
        display: none;
      }

      .hero-grid,
      .section-head,
      .state-layout,
      .waitlist-box,
      .form-layout,
      .starter-layout {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
      }

      .hero-grid {
        gap: 44px;
      }

      .hero-card {
        max-width: 680px;
      }

      .section-head {
        gap: 22px;
        margin-bottom: 42px;
      }

      .section-head p {
        max-width: 780px;
      }

      .evidence-grid,
      .info-grid,
      .rule-grid,
      .notification-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      }

      .ticket-grid {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
      }

      .ticket {
        padding: 40px;
      }

      .ticket-price {
        font-size: 42px;
      }

      .ticket-actions {
        margin-top: 12px;
      }

      .form-layout {
        align-items: stretch;
      }

      .summary-card {
        height: auto;
      }

      .starter-preview {
        min-height: 340px;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      body {
        font-size: 18px;
        line-height: 1.8;
      }

      .wrap {
        width: min(calc(100% - 32px), var(--max));
      }

      .prototype-bar {
        padding: 14px 18px;
        font-size: 16px;
        line-height: 1.6;
      }

      header {
        position: relative !important;
      }

      nav {
        min-height: 72px;
        gap: 12px;
      }

      .brand {
        gap: 10px;
        font-size: 18px;
      }

      .brand-mark {
        width: 40px;
        height: 40px;
      }

      .nav-links {
        gap: 10px;
      }

      .nav-links .button {
        min-height: 48px;
        padding: 10px 16px;
      }

      .prototype-bar,
      .tag,
      .eyebrow,
      .nav-links a,
      .fact-label,
      .status-badge,
      .log-time,
      button,
      .button,
      .overline {
        font-size: 16px;
      }

      .note,
      .ticket-meta {
        font-size: 18px;
      }

      h1 {
        font-size: clamp(36px, 10.5vw, 48px);
        line-height: 1.13;
        letter-spacing: -.04em;
        margin-bottom: 26px;
      }

      h2,
      .section-head h2 {
        font-size: 32px;
        line-height: 1.22;
        letter-spacing: -.025em;
      }

      h3 {
        font-size: 24px;
        line-height: 1.4;
      }

      .hero {
        padding: 64px 0;
      }

      .hero-grid {
        gap: 36px;
      }

      .eyebrow {
        margin-bottom: 24px;
      }

      .lead {
        font-size: 20px;
        line-height: 1.85;
      }

      .hero-actions,
      .controls {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
        gap: 12px;
        margin-top: 32px;
      }

      .hero-actions > *,
      .controls > *,
      .ticket-actions > * {
        width: 100%;
      }

      .hero-facts {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
        gap: 22px;
        margin-top: 46px;
      }

      .fact {
        padding-top: 18px;
      }

      .fact-value {
        margin-top: 8px;
        font-size: 18px;
      }

      .hero-card,
      .card,
      form.card,
      .summary-card {
        border-radius: 20px;
      }

      .hero-card,
      .info-card,
      .ticket,
      .status-panel,
      .simulation-panel,
      .rule-card,
      .queue,
      .waitlist-form,
      .notification-card,
      form.card,
      .summary-card {
        padding: 28px;
      }

      .hero-card h3 {
        font-size: 30px;
        margin-top: 28px;
      }

      .hero-card p {
        line-height: 1.85;
      }

      .seat-meter {
        margin-top: 32px;
      }

      .meter-row {
        font-size: 16px;
      }

      section {
        padding: 68px 0;
      }

      .section-head {
        gap: 20px;
        margin-bottom: 34px;
      }

      .section-head p,
      p,
      .muted,
      .info-row dd,
      .agenda-item,
      .summary-row,
      details > div,
      .notification,
      .queue-item,
      label,
      legend,
      input,
      select,
      textarea {
        font-size: 18px;
      }

      .section-head p,
      .info-card p,
      .rule-card p,
      .notification-card p {
        line-height: 1.85;
      }

      .evidence-grid,
      .info-grid,
      .rule-grid,
      .notification-grid,
      .ticket-grid {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
        gap: 20px;
      }

      .photo-placeholder {
        min-height: 240px;
        padding: 28px;
      }

      .photo-placeholder strong {
        font-size: 24px;
      }

      .photo-placeholder .note {
        font-size: 18px;
      }

      .evidence {
        min-height: auto;
        padding: 28px;
      }

      .info-list {
        gap: 0;
      }

      .info-row,
      .agenda-item {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
        gap: 8px;
        padding: 22px 0;
      }

      .info-row dt {
        font-size: 18px;
      }

      .agenda {
        margin-top: 18px;
      }

      .agenda-time {
        font-size: 18px;
      }

      .agenda-item strong {
        margin-bottom: 8px;
      }

      .ticket {
        gap: 0;
      }

      .ticket-price {
        margin-top: 30px;
        font-size: clamp(34px, 10vw, 42px);
      }

      .ticket-meta {
        gap: 12px;
        margin: 28px 0;
        padding: 24px 0;
        line-height: 1.75;
      }

      .steps {
        margin-top: 30px;
      }

      .step {
        grid-template-columns: 42px minmax(0, 1fr);
        gap: 16px;
        padding: 18px;
      }

      .step-no {
        width: 42px;
        height: 42px;
      }

      .notification {
        padding: 22px;
        margin-top: 26px;
      }

      .waitlist-box {
        gap: 20px;
      }

      .queue-item {
        padding: 18px;
      }

      .fields {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
        gap: 26px;
      }

      .field {
        gap: 10px;
      }

      input,
      select,
      textarea {
        min-height: 58px;
        padding: 14px 16px;
        font-size: 18px;
        border-radius: 12px;
      }

      textarea {
        min-height: 150px;
      }

      .check-row {
        grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0, 1fr);
        gap: 14px;
      }

      .check-row .note {
        font-size: 18px;
      }

      .validation {
        font-size: 16px;
      }

      .summary-list {
        margin-top: 30px;
        gap: 18px;
      }

      .summary-row {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
        gap: 6px;
        padding-bottom: 18px;
      }

      .summary-row strong {
        text-align: left;
      }

      details {
        margin-top: 16px;
      }

      summary {
        padding: 22px 24px;
        font-size: 18px;
        line-height: 1.6;
      }

      details > div {
        padding: 0 24px 28px;
        line-height: 1.85;
      }

      /*
        手機表格轉換為逐筆卡片：
        保留原本 table、thead、tbody、tr、td 結構，
        並利用既有 JavaScript 加上的 data-label
        在每個儲存格前顯示對應欄位名稱。
      */

      .table-wrap,
      .table-scroll {
        overflow: visible !important;
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 100%;
        border: 0;
        border-radius: 0;
        background: transparent;
        box-shadow: none;
        margin-top: 22px;
      }

      table {
        display: block;
        width: 100% !important;
        min-width: 0 !important;
        border-collapse: separate;
        font-size: 18px;
      }

      thead {
        position: absolute;
        width: 1px;
        height: 1px;
        padding: 0;
        margin: -1px;
        overflow: hidden;
        clip-path: inset(50%);
        white-space: nowrap;
        border: 0;
      }

      tbody {
        display: grid;
        width: 100%;
        gap: 18px;
      }

      tr {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        min-width: 0;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 22px;
        border: 1px solid var(--line);
        border-radius: 18px;
        background: var(--paper);
        box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(29, 49, 41, .05);
      }

      tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
        background: var(--paper);
      }

      td {
        display: grid !important;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
        gap: 6px;
        min-width: 0 !important;
        width: 100% !important;
        max-width: 100%;
        padding: 16px 0 !important;
        border: 0 !important;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line) !important;
        background: transparent;
        font-size: 18px !important;
        line-height: 1.75;
        text-align: left;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        word-break: normal;
        white-space: normal;
      }

      td:first-child {
        padding-top: 0 !important;
      }

      td:last-child {
        padding-bottom: 0 !important;
        border-bottom: 0 !important;
      }

      td[data-label]::before {
        content: attr(data-label);
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 2px;
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 16px;
        line-height: 1.5;
        font-weight: 900;
      }

      td[colspan] {
        display: block !important;
        min-height: auto;
        padding: 0 !important;
        border-bottom: 0 !important;
      }

      td[colspan][data-label]::before {
        margin-bottom: 10px;
      }

      .data-section h3 {
        margin-top: 0;
        margin-bottom: 18px;
      }

      .data-section h3[style] {
        margin-top: 44px !important;
      }

      .data-section .card[style] {
        padding: 28px !important;
        margin-top: 44px !important;
      }

      .log {
        margin-top: 24px;
      }

      .log li {
        padding: 20px 0;
      }

      .log-time {
        font-size: 16px;
      }

      .danger-zone {
        padding: 28px;
        margin-top: 36px;
      }

      .danger-zone button {
        width: 100%;
      }

      .starter {
        padding: 68px 0;
      }

      .starter h2 {
        margin-bottom: 30px;
        font-size: 32px;
        line-height: 1.22;
      }

      .starter-layout {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
        gap: 20px;
      }

      .starter-form,
      .starter-preview {
        padding: 28px;
        border-radius: 20px;
      }

      .starter-form {
        gap: 24px;
      }

      .starter-preview {
        min-height: 280px;
      }

      .starter-preview h3 {
        font-size: 32px;
        line-height: 1.35;
        margin: 20px 0;
      }

      .starter-preview p {
        font-size: 20px;
        line-height: 1.8;
      }

      .starter-preview small {
        font-size: 16px;
      }

      .starter label,
      .starter input {
        font-size: 18px;
      }

      .footer {
        padding: 56px 0 72px;
      }

      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
        gap: 28px;
      }

      .footer .button {
        width: 100%;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 380px) {
      .wrap {
        width: min(calc(100% - 28px), var(--max));
      }

      .hero-card,
      .info-card,
      .ticket,
      .status-panel,
      .simulation-panel,
      .rule-card,
      .queue,
      .waitlist-form,
      .notification-card,
      form.card,
      .summary-card,
      .evidence,
      .starter-form,
      .starter-preview {
        padding: 22px;
      }

      .hero-card h3 {
        font-size: 28px;
      }

      tr {
        padding: 18px;
      }

      .ticket-price {
        font-size: 34px;
      }
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      html {
        scroll-behavior: auto;
      }

      .button,
      button {
        transition: none;
      }
    }
  @media(max-width:1024px){.ticket-grid,.trust-grid,.form-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:640px){.ticket-grid,.trust-grid,.form-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}header{display:flex;flex-direction:column}header nav{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;padding:20px 0}.btn,.sim-btn{display:block;width:100%;text-align:center}}
</style>
<style id="k23b-style">
.textbook-block{max-width:1120px;margin:48px auto;padding:32px;background:#fffdf9;border:1px solid #d9ddd8;border-radius:20px;color:#1f2825;font-size:20px;line-height:1.7}
.textbook-block h2{font-size:32px;line-height:1.45;margin:0 0 20px}.textbook-block p{margin:16px 0}.textbook-block summary{cursor:pointer;font-size:22px;padding:16px 20px}.textbook-block details{border:1px solid #d9ddd8;border-radius:12px;margin:16px 0;padding:8px}.textbook-block details p{padding:0 20px 16px}.textbook-block button,.textbook-block select{font:inherit;padding:14px 22px;min-height:52px;margin:8px;border:1px solid #1f5b4d;border-radius:10px;background:white;color:#1f2825}.textbook-block .selected{background:#1f5b4d;color:white}.textbook-block .booked{background:#eee;color:#666}.textbook-block code{font-size:18px;word-break:break-word}
@media(max-width:640px){.textbook-block{margin:24px 16px;padding:24px}.textbook-block button,.textbook-block select{max-width:100%;margin:8px 0}}
</style><style id="k23b-gate-fix">h1,h2,h3{text-wrap:balance}button:disabled{opacity:1!important;color:#394640!important;background:#e2e7e3!important} @media(max-width:640px){.wrap{width:calc(100% - 48px)!important}.textbook-block{padding:24px 20px}.textbook-block h2{font-size:32px;line-height:1.5} #registrationForm .card{padding:20px} #ticket{padding:10px 12px}}
</style></head>

<body>
  <div class="prototype-bar">
    教學虛構示例｜品牌策略工作坊報名流程原型｜未接正式金流、通知服務或後台資料庫
  </div>

  <header>
    <div class="wrap">
      <nav aria-label="主要導覽">
        <a class="brand" href="#top">
          <span class="brand-mark">B</span>
          <span>品牌策略工作坊</span>
        </a>

        <div class="nav-links">
          <a href="#info">活動資訊</a>
          <a href="#tickets">票種</a>
          <a href="#rules">規則</a>
          <a class="button primary" href="#register">開始報名</a>
        </div>
      </nav>
    </div>
  </header>

  <main id="top">
    <section class="hero">
      <div class="wrap hero-grid">
        <div>
          <div class="eyebrow">教學虛構示例 · 2026 / 11 / 14</div>
          <h1>把品牌從「我想說什麼」，整理成「客人為什麼選我」。</h1>
          <p class="lead">
            「品牌策略工作坊」是一個教學虛構情境，帶著參與者從目標客群與真實需求開始，
            依序釐清品牌價值、差異化、定位與溝通訊息，最後整理成可用於網站、
            提案與內容溝通的品牌策略骨架。
          </p>

          <div class="hero-actions">
            <a class="button primary" href="#tickets">查看票種與名額</a>
            <a class="button secondary" href="#info">先看工作坊內容</a>
          </div>

          <div class="hero-facts">
            <div class="fact">
              <div class="fact-label">日期</div>
              <div class="fact-value">2026 年 11 月 14 日</div>
            </div>
            <div class="fact">
              <div class="fact-label">地點</div>
              <div class="fact-value">教學示意場地</div>
            </div>
            <div class="fact">
              <div class="fact-label">主辦</div>
              <div class="fact-value">教學示例工作室</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <aside class="hero-card" aria-label="早鳥票剩餘名額">
          <span class="tag">目前示例狀態</span>
          <h3 id="heroSeatTitle">早鳥票只剩 1 名</h3>
          <p>
            本案例保留完整報名流程示範。送出報名時會再次檢查本機教學庫存，
            第一位成功取得待付款名額後，下一位不能讓庫存變成負數。
          </p>

          <div class="seat-meter">
            <div class="meter-row">
              <span>早鳥票示例容量</span>
              <span id="heroSeatText">剩餘 1 / 10</span>
            </div>
            <div class="meter" aria-hidden="true"><span id="heroMeter"></span></div>
          </div>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="trust">
      <div class="wrap">
        <div class="section-head">
          <div>
            <span class="overline">Trust Evidence</span>
            <h2>沒有證據，就不要假裝有。</h2>
          </div>
          <p>
            本案例沒有提供真實活動照片、講者履歷、學員成果或評論，因此保留證據位置，
            但明確標記為教學占位，不捏造內容。
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="evidence-grid trust-grid">
          <div class="photo-placeholder">
            <div>
              <strong>活動照片位置</strong>
              <span class="note">教學虛構示例｜目前沒有可用真實照片，因此不載入外部圖片。</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <article class="card evidence">
            <span class="overline">講者資料</span>
            <h3>不編造履歷</h3>
            <p class="muted">
              正式上線時可放姓名、角色與經核實的經歷。本原型沒有提供講者真實資料。
            </p>
          </article>

          <article class="card evidence">
            <span class="overline">規則透明</span>
            <h3>先把流程說清楚</h3>
            <p class="muted">
              票種、庫存、付款、候補、取消與資料使用方式，都在送出之前可以閱讀。
            </p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="info">
      <div class="wrap">
        <div class="section-head">
          <div>
            <span class="overline">Brand Strategy</span>
            <h2>從客群、需求一路推到定位與訊息。</h2>
          </div>
          <p>
            以下活動內容皆為教學虛構示例。重點不是創造一組好聽的品牌形容詞，
            而是建立前後一致、可以拿來做決策的品牌策略。
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="info-grid">
          <article class="card info-card">
            <h3>活動基本資訊</h3>
            <dl class="info-list">
              <div class="info-row">
                <dt>活動名稱</dt>
                <dd>品牌策略工作坊</dd>
              </div>
              <div class="info-row">
                <dt>日期</dt>
                <dd>2026 年 11 月 14 日</dd>
              </div>
              <div class="info-row">
                <dt>地點</dt>
                <dd>教學示意場地｜非真實活動地址</dd>
              </div>
              <div class="info-row">
                <dt>主辦單位</dt>
                <dd>教學示例工作室</dd>
              </div>
              <div class="info-row">
                <dt>活動狀態</dt>
                <dd>教學示例：開放報名</dd>
              </div>
            </dl>
          </article>

          <article class="card info-card">
            <h3>適合對象與需求</h3>
            <p class="muted">
              適合已經有產品、服務、專案或品牌概念，但常遇到「客群太廣」、
              「跟競品很像」、「每次介紹自己都說得不一樣」、
              「網站和社群文案沒有共同主軸」等問題的學習者。
            </p>

            <h3 style="margin-top:30px">工作坊產出方向</h3>
            <p class="muted">
              將目標客群、需求情境、品牌價值、差異化、品牌定位與溝通訊息
              串成一條策略鏈，讓後續網站、簡報、銷售頁與內容創作有共同判斷基準。
            </p>
          </article>
        </div>

        <div class="card info-card" style="margin-top:18px">
          <h3>當日議程｜教學虛構示例</h3>
          <div class="agenda">
            <div class="agenda-item">
              <div class="agenda-time">09:30–10:00</div>
              <div>
                <strong>品牌問題盤點：你現在到底在賣給誰？</strong><br>
                <span class="muted">
                  先拆解現況、目標客群與品牌目前遇到的選擇問題，不從 Logo、顏色或口號開始。
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="agenda-item">
              <div class="agenda-time">10:00–12:00</div>
              <div>
                <strong>目標客群 × 需求 × 使用情境</strong><br>
                <span class="muted">
                  定義核心客群、觸發需求的情境、正在解決的問題，以及客人真正想得到的結果。
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="agenda-item">
              <div class="agenda-time">13:30–15:00</div>
              <div>
                <strong>品牌價值 × 差異化 × 選擇理由</strong><br>
                <span class="muted">
                  從客人重視的價值出發，比較其他替代方案，找出不是自我宣稱、而是能被理解的差異。
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="agenda-item">
              <div class="agenda-time">15:20–17:00</div>
              <div>
                <strong>定位 × 溝通訊息 × 實際應用</strong><br>
                <span class="muted">
                  將前面的判斷收斂為品牌定位與核心訊息，並練習轉換成首頁、提案與對外介紹的溝通結構。
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="info-grid" style="margin-top:22px">
          <article class="card info-card">
            <span class="overline">Brand Value</span>
            <h3>品牌價值：你替客人創造什麼改變？</h3>
            <p class="muted">
              不只回答「我們提供什麼」，而是從客人的角度說明：
              選擇這個品牌之後，他能降低什麼成本、避免什麼風險、
              獲得什麼結果，或完成什麼原本很難完成的事情。
            </p>
          </article>

          <article class="card info-card">
            <span class="overline">Differentiation</span>
            <h3>差異化：不是不同而已，而是值得被選。</h3>
            <p class="muted">
              差異必須同時和目標客群、需求情境與品牌能力有關。
              工作坊會練習把「我們比較專業、比較用心、品質比較好」
              這類模糊描述，轉成客人能判斷的選擇理由。
            </p>
          </article>

          <article class="card info-card">
            <span class="overline">Positioning</span>
            <h3>品牌定位：在特定客群心中占一個清楚位置。</h3>
            <p class="muted">
              定位會回答：我們主要服務誰、在什麼情境下出現、
              解決什麼關鍵問題、提供什麼核心價值，以及相較其他選項，
              為什麼應該優先想到我們。
            </p>
          </article>

          <article class="card info-card">
            <span class="overline">Message</span>
            <h3>溝通訊息：把策略翻譯成人聽得懂的話。</h3>
            <p class="muted">
              最後不只留下一份策略文件，而是把定位轉成可重複使用的核心訊息：
              首頁第一屏說什麼、品牌自我介紹怎麼說、提案先講什麼，
              以及哪些內容不該再互相矛盾。
            </p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="tickets">
      <div class="wrap">
        <div class="section-head">
          <div>
            <span class="overline">Ticket Type</span>
            <h2>先看價格，也看名額與期限。</h2>
          </div>
          <p>
            所有價格皆明確標示為「教學虛構示例價格」，不是實際販售資訊。
            切換票種會同步更新下方報名摘要。
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="ticket-grid">
          <article class="card ticket active" data-ticket-card="early">
            <span class="tag">教學虛構示例</span>
            <h3 style="margin-top:18px">早鳥票</h3>
            <div class="ticket-price">NT$ 5,000</div>
            <div class="note">教學虛構示例價格</div>

            <div class="ticket-meta">
              <span>開賣：2026 / 10 / 01 09:00</span>
              <span>截止：2026 / 10 / 31 23:59</span>
              <strong id="earlySeatText">剩餘名額：1 / 10</strong>
            </div>

            <div class="ticket-actions">
              <button class="primary ticket-select" data-ticket="early">選擇早鳥票</button>
              <button class="secondary waitlist-open" data-ticket="early" hidden>加入候補</button>
            </div>
          </article>

          <article class="card ticket" data-ticket-card="general">
            <span class="tag">教學虛構示例</span>
            <h3 style="margin-top:18px">一般票</h3>
            <div class="ticket-price">NT$ 6,000</div>
            <div class="note">教學虛構示例價格</div>

            <div class="ticket-meta">
              <span>開賣：2026 / 11 / 01 09:00</span>
              <span>截止：2026 / 11 / 12 23:59</span>
              <strong>示例名額：12 / 20</strong>
            </div>

            <div class="ticket-actions">
              <button class="primary ticket-select" data-ticket="general">選擇一般票</button>
            </div>
          </article>

          <article class="card ticket" data-ticket-card="student">
            <span class="tag">教學虛構示例</span>
            <h3 style="margin-top:18px">學生票</h3>
            <div class="ticket-price">NT$ 4,500</div>
            <div class="note">教學虛構示例價格｜現場資格驗證僅為說明</div>

            <div class="ticket-meta">
              <span>開賣：2026 / 10 / 01 09:00</span>
              <span>截止：2026 / 11 / 12 23:59</span>
              <strong>示例名額：5 / 8</strong>
            </div>

            <div class="ticket-actions">
              <button class="primary ticket-select" data-ticket="student">選擇學生票</button>
            </div>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="process">
      <div class="wrap">
        <div class="section-head">
          <div>
            <span class="overline">Registration State</span>
            <h2>報名不是只有「成功」或「失敗」。</h2>
          </div>
          <p>
            此區將 Registration、PaymentRecord、WaitlistEntry 與 NotificationLog
            轉成使用者能理解的流程。
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="state-layout">
          <article class="card status-panel">
            <span id="registrationBadge" class="status-badge">尚未報名</span>
            <h3 id="registrationTitle" style="margin-top:20px">目前沒有進行中的報名</h3>
            <p id="registrationDescription" class="muted">
              填寫下方表單後，成功取得名額的第一筆會先進入「待付款」。
            </p>

            <div class="steps">
              <div class="step" data-step="pending">
                <span class="step-no">1</span>
                <div><strong>待付款</strong><br><span class="note">庫存已暫時保留。</span></div>
              </div>
              <div class="step" data-step="paid">
                <span class="step-no">2</span>
                <div><strong>已付款</strong><br><span class="note">教學模擬付款紀錄成立。</span></div>
              </div>
              <div class="step" data-step="confirmed">
                <span class="step-no">3</span>
                <div><strong>已確認</strong><br><span class="note">正式系統通常還會產生票券或報到資料。</span></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </article>

          <article class="card simulation-panel">
            <span class="overline">教學模擬</span>
            <h3>狀態控制台</h3>
            <p class="muted">
              以下按鈕只修改瀏覽器 localStorage 教學資料，
              不代表真實付款、不會真的退款，也不會真的發送通知。
            </p>

            <div class="controls">
              <button id="simulatePaid" class="primary" disabled>教學模擬：付款成功</button>
              <button id="simulateTimeout" class="warning" disabled>教學模擬：付款逾時</button>
              <button id="simulateCancel" class="danger" disabled>教學模擬：取消報名</button>
              <button id="simulateConfirm" class="secondary" disabled>教學模擬：確認報名</button>
            </div>

            <div id="latestNotification" class="notification" aria-live="polite">
              <strong>通知紀錄</strong>
              尚無通知。所有通知皆僅示意未發送。
            </div>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="waitlist">
      <div class="wrap">
        <div class="section-head">
          <div>
            <span class="overline">Waitlist</span>
            <h2>名額沒有了，就把候補規則說完整。</h2>
          </div>
          <p>
            當早鳥票售完，報名鍵會立即停用並出現候補入口。
            隊首收到名額後保留 10 分鐘，逾時再依順位遞補。
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="rule-grid">
          <article class="card rule-card">
            <h3>候補釋出規則</h3>
            <p class="muted">
              前一位待付款者若付款逾時，系統示意會先釋放他的名額，
              再將這一席「保留給候補隊首 10 分鐘」。
            </p>
          </article>

          <article class="card rule-card">
            <h3>10 分鐘後怎麼辦？</h3>
            <p class="muted">
              若隊首在保留期限內未完成下一步，正式系統應解除保留，
              並依候補順位通知下一位。本原型只模擬狀態與紀錄。

          </article>
        </div>

        <div class="waitlist-box">
          <article class="card queue">
            <h3>候補順位</h3>

              <p class="muted">目前沒有人候補。</p>
            </div>

        <div class="notification-grid">
          <article class="card notification-card">

            <h3>活動前提醒</h3>

            <h3>異動通知</h3>

          <aside class="card summary-card">

              這是瀏覽器端教學原型。正式系統不可只靠前端 localStorage 控制真實庫存，
              必須由伺服器或資料庫做原子交易與併發控制。
            </div>

        </div>

          <p>

            本原型沒有真實付款，因此不會真的退款。正式活動應依實際主辦方政策清楚列出
            可退款期限、手續費、不可退款條件與退款方式。
          </div>
        </details>

        <details>
          <summary>名額保留｜教學虛構示例</summary>
          <div class="muted">
            成功送出報名只代表取得待付款名額。付款逾時後，該席次可被釋放。
            候補隊首取得釋出名額後，本原型示範保留 10 分鐘。
          </div>
        </details>

        <details>
          <summary>隱私與個資用途｜教學虛構示例</summary>
          <div class="muted">
            本頁資料只存在使用者目前瀏覽器的 localStorage。正式服務應說明資料蒐集者、
            使用目的、保存期限、聯絡方式與使用者如何要求查詢、更正或刪除。
          </div>
        </details>

        <details>
          <summary>同意撤回｜教學虛構示例</summary>
          <div class="muted">
            本原型以「重置教學資料」作為本機資料清除示範。正式服務的活動必要聯絡與
            行銷同意應分開管理，行銷同意不得預勾。
          </div>
        </details>

    <section class="data-section" id="data">
      <div class="wrap">
        <div class="section-head">

            以下表格把 Event、EventSession、TicketType、Registration、

                <th>保留期限</th>
              </tr>

        <h3 style="margin-top:42px">ConsentRecord</h3>
        <div class="table-wrap">

            <thead>
              <tr>

            </thead>

              <tr><td colspan="5" data-label="對象">尚無同意紀錄。</td></tr>
            </tbody>

        <div class="card" style="padding:28px;margin-top:42px">

            清除這個瀏覽器中由本頁建立的 Registration、PaymentRecord、
            WaitlistEntry、NotificationLog 與 ConsentRecord，並將早鳥票恢復為剩餘 1 名。
          </p>

    </section>

    <section class="starter" id="your-start"><div class="wrap"><h2>從你的活動開始</h2><div class="starter-layout"><form class="starter-form" onsubmit="return false" aria-label="整理自己的素材"><label for="your-0">活動名稱<input id="your-0" autocomplete="off" placeholder="填入你自己的活動名稱" /></label><label for="your-1">日期與時間<input id="your-1" autocomplete="off" placeholder="填入你自己的日期與時間" /></label><label for="your-2">真實規則<input id="your-2" autocomplete="off" placeholder="填入你自己的真實規則" /></label></form><article class="starter-preview" aria-live="polite"><small>你的網站起點</small><h3 id="your-title">你的活動，從這裡開始</h3><p id="your-detail">日期與時間，由你填入。</p><hr><p id="your-boundary">真實規則，先說清楚。</p></article></div></div></section>
  </main>

  <footer class="footer">
    <div class="wrap footer-grid">
      <div>
        <strong>品牌策略工作坊</strong>
        <p class="note">
          教學虛構示例，非真實營業活動；頁面未接正式金流、通知服務或後台資料庫。
        </p>
      </div>
      <a class="button secondary" href="#top">回到頁首</a>
    </div>
  </footer>

  <script>
    (() => {
      "use strict";

      const STORAGE_KEY = "event-registration-teaching-prototype-v1";

      const ticketCatalog = {
        early: {
          id: "ticket-early",
          name: "早鳥票",
          price: 5000,
          capacity: 10,
          initialRemaining: 1,
          salesStart: "2026-10-01T09:00:00+08:00",
          salesEnd: "2026-10-31T23:59:00+08:00"
        },
        general: {
          id: "ticket-general",
          name: "一般票",
          price: 6000,
          capacity: 20,
          initialRemaining: 12,
          salesStart: "2026-11-01T09:00:00+08:00",
          salesEnd: "2026-11-12T23:59:00+08:00"
        },
        student: {
          id: "ticket-student",
          name: "學生票",
          price: 4500,
          capacity: 8,
          initialRemaining: 5,
          salesStart: "2026-10-01T09:00:00+08:00",
          salesEnd: "2026-11-12T23:59:00+08:00"
        }
      };

      const defaultState = () => ({
        version: 1,
        tickets: {
          early: 1,
          general: 12,
          student: 5
        },
        registrations: [],
        payments: [],
        waitlist: [],
        notifications: [],
        consents: [],
        selectedTicket: "early"
      });

      let state = loadState();

      const $ = (selector) => document.querySelector(selector);
      const $$ = (selector) => [...document.querySelectorAll(selector)];

      function loadState() {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY));
          if (!parsed || parsed.version !== 1) return defaultState();
          return {
            ...defaultState(),
            ...parsed,
            tickets: { ...defaultState().tickets, ...(parsed.tickets || {}) },
            registrations: parsed.registrations || [],
            payments: parsed.payments || [],
            waitlist: parsed.waitlist || [],
            notifications: parsed.notifications || [],
            consents: parsed.consents || []
          };
        } catch {
          return defaultState();
        }
      }

      function saveState() {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
      }

      function uid(prefix) {
        return prefix + "-" + Date.now() + "-" + Math.random().toString(16).slice(2);
      }

      function nowISO() {
        return new Date().toISOString();
      }

      function formatTime(iso) {
        if (!iso) return "—";
        return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("zh-TW", {
          year: "numeric",
          month: "2-digit",
          day: "2-digit",
          hour: "2-digit",
          minute: "2-digit",
          hour12: false
        }).format(new Date(iso));
      }

      function money(value) {
        return "NT$ " + Number(value).toLocaleString("zh-TW");
      }

      function escapeHTML(value) {
        return String(value ?? "")
          .replaceAll("&", "&amp;")
          .replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
          .replaceAll(">", "&gt;")
          .replaceAll('"', "&quot;")
          .replaceAll("'", "&#039;");
      }

      function notify(target, content) {
        const record = {
          id: uid("notice"),
          target,
          content,
          channel: "教學示意通道",
          status: "教學示意未發送",
          createdAt: nowISO()
        };

        state.notifications.unshift(record);
        saveState();
        render();
        return record;
      }

      function getActiveRegistration() {
        return state.registrations.find(r =>
          ["pending_payment", "paid", "confirmed", "waitlist_reserved"].includes(r.status)
        ) || null;
      }

      function registrationStatusLabel(status) {
        return ({
          pending_payment: "待付款",
          paid: "已付款",
          confirmed: "已確認",
          payment_timeout: "付款逾時",
          cancelled: "已取消",
          waitlist_reserved: "候補名額保留中"
        })[status] || "未知";
      }

      function paymentStatusLabel(status) {
        return ({
          pending: "待付款",
          success: "付款成功（教學模擬）",
          timeout: "付款逾時（教學模擬）",
          cancelled: "已取消（教學模擬）",
          none: "尚未建立"
        })[status] || status;
      }

      function setSelectedTicket(ticketKey) {
        if (!ticketCatalog[ticketKey]) return;
        state.selectedTicket = ticketKey;
        saveState();
        $("#ticket").value = ticketKey;
        render();
        document.querySelector("#register").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
      }

      function addRegistration(event) {
        event.preventDefault();

        const name = $("#name").value.trim();
        const contact = $("#contact").value.trim();
        const ticketKey = $("#ticket").value;
        const memo = $("#memo").value.trim();
        const privacy = $("#privacyConsent").checked;
        const marketing = $("#marketingConsent").checked;

        $("#formValidation").textContent = "";

        if (!name || !contact) {
          $("#formValidation").textContent = "請先填寫姓名與聯絡方式。";
          return;
        }

        if (!privacy) {
          $("#formValidation").textContent = "請先同意本次活動報名必要的個資使用說明。";
          return;
        }

        /*
          教學版「原子檢查」：
          JavaScript 是單執行緒，因此在同一次同步操作中，
          先讀目前 localStorage state，再扣除一席並立即寫回。

          這只能防止本頁教學操作把數字扣成負數。
          真實多人同時報名仍必須由伺服器 / 資料庫交易處理。
        */
        const available = Number(state.tickets[ticketKey] || 0);

        if (available <= 0) {
          if (ticketKey === "early") {
            $("#formValidation").textContent =
              "早鳥票已售完，這筆報名沒有建立，也沒有產生待付款名額。請改加入候補。";
            render();
            return;
          }

          $("#formValidation").textContent = "此票種目前已無剩餘名額。";
          render();
          return;
        }

        state.tickets[ticketKey] = Math.max(0, available - 1);

        const registrationId = uid("reg");
        const registration = {
          id: registrationId,
          name,
          contact,
          ticketKey,
          ticketName: ticketCatalog[ticketKey].name,
          memo,
          status: "pending_payment",
          paymentStatus: "pending",
          checkinStatus: "未報到",
          createdAt: nowISO()
        };

        state.registrations.push(registration);

        state.payments.push({
          id: uid("payment"),
          registrationId,
          amount: ticketCatalog[ticketKey].price,
          method: "尚未選擇｜教學示例",
          result: "待付款",
          transactionTime: null
        });

        state.consents.push({
          id: uid("consent"),
          registrationId,
          target: name,
          purpose: "活動報名、聯繫、付款狀態與候補處理",
          consentTime: nowISO(),
          marketingConsent: marketing,
          withdrawalMethod: "本原型可使用「重置教學資料」清除本機資料"
        });

        state.notifications.unshift({
          id: uid("notice"),
          target: name,
          content: `已建立 ${ticketCatalog[ticketKey].name} 待付款報名。這只是教學模擬，尚未完成真實付款。`,
          channel: "教學示意通道",
          status: "教學示意未發送",
          createdAt: nowISO()
        });

        saveState();

        $("#registrationForm").reset();
        $("#ticket").value = ticketKey;
        state.selectedTicket = ticketKey;
        saveState();

        render();
        document.querySelector("#process").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
      }

      function addWaitlist(event) {
        event.preventDefault();

        const name = $("#waitlistName").value.trim();
        const contact = $("#waitlistContact").value.trim();

        $("#waitlistValidation").textContent = "";

        if (state.tickets.early > 0) {
          $("#waitlistValidation").textContent =
            "目前仍有早鳥票名額，候補入口尚未開啟。";
          return;
        }

        if (!name || !contact) {
          $("#waitlistValidation").textContent = "請填寫候補姓名與聯絡方式。";
          return;
        }

        const duplicate = state.waitlist.some(
          item => item.name === name && ["waiting", "reserved"].includes(item.status)
        );

        if (duplicate) {
          $("#waitlistValidation").textContent = "這個姓名已有進行中的候補紀錄。";
          return;
        }

        const entry = {
          id: uid("wait"),
          name,
          contact,
          ticketKey: "early",
          rank: state.waitlist.filter(x => ["waiting", "reserved"].includes(x.status)).length + 1,
          status: "waiting",
          notificationTime: null,
          reservedUntil: null,
          createdAt: nowISO()
        };

        state.waitlist.push(entry);

        state.notifications.unshift({
          id: uid("notice"),
          target: name,
          content: `已加入早鳥票候補，目前順位為第 ${entry.rank} 位。`,
          channel: "教學示意通道",
          status: "教學示意未發送",
          createdAt: nowISO()
        });

        saveState();
        $("#waitlistForm").reset();
        render();
      }

      function simulatePaid() {
        const registration = getActiveRegistration();
        if (!registration || registration.status !== "pending_payment") return;

        registration.status = "paid";
        registration.paymentStatus = "success";

        const payment = state.payments.find(p => p.registrationId === registration.id);
        if (payment) {
          payment.method = "教學模擬付款方式";
          payment.result = "付款成功（教學模擬）";
          payment.transactionTime = nowISO();
        }

        state.notifications.unshift({
          id: uid("notice"),
          target: registration.name,
          content: "報名成功：付款完成，請核對活動資訊、票種與報到方式。這只是教學模擬，沒有真實交易。",
          channel: "教學示意通道",
          status: "教學示意未發送",
          createdAt: nowISO()
        });

        saveState();
        render();
      }

      function simulateConfirm() {
        const registration = getActiveRegistration();
        if (!registration || registration.status !== "paid") return;

        registration.status = "confirmed";

        state.notifications.unshift({
          id: uid("notice"),
          target: registration.name,
          content: "報名狀態已切換為已確認。正式系統通常會再產生票券或報到資訊。",
          channel: "教學示意通道",
          status: "教學示意未發送",
          createdAt: nowISO()
        });

        saveState();
        render();
      }

      function releaseSeat(registration) {
        const ticketKey = registration.ticketKey;
        const capacity = ticketCatalog[ticketKey].capacity;
        state.tickets[ticketKey] = Math.min(
          capacity,
          Number(state.tickets[ticketKey] || 0) + 1
        );
      }

      function reserveForWaitlistHead() {
        const waiting = state.waitlist
          .filter(item => item.status === "waiting")
          .sort((a, b) => a.rank - b.rank);

        const head = waiting[0];

        if (!head || state.tickets.early <= 0) return null;

        /*
          先有可用名額，再將一席保留給隊首。
          保留時立即從公開庫存扣掉，避免同一席又被一般報名拿走。
        */
        state.tickets.early = Math.max(0, state.tickets.early - 1);

        const now = new Date();
        const reservedUntil = new Date(now.getTime() + 10 * 60 * 1000);

        head.status = "reserved";
        head.notificationTime = now.toISOString();
        head.reservedUntil = reservedUntil.toISOString();

        state.notifications.unshift({
          id: uid("notice"),
          target: head.name,
          content:
            "早鳥票已有 1 席釋出，現在保留給候補隊首 10 分鐘。",
          channel: "教學示意通道",
          status: "教學示意未發送",
          createdAt: now.toISOString()
        });

        return head;
      }

      function simulateTimeout() {
        const registration = getActiveRegistration();
        if (!registration || registration.status !== "pending_payment") return;

        registration.status = "cancelled";
        registration.cancelReason = "payment_timeout"; // 教學模擬：付款逾時後轉取消
        registration.paymentStatus = "timeout";

        const payment = state.payments.find(p => p.registrationId === registration.id);
        if (payment) {
          payment.result = "付款逾時（教學模擬）";
          payment.transactionTime = nowISO();
        }

        /*
          規格要求：
          1. 先釋放第一筆名額
          2. 再保留給候補隊首 10 分鐘
        */
        releaseSeat(registration);

        state.notifications.unshift({
          id: uid("notice"),
          target: registration.name,
          content:
            "付款保留期限已逾時，報名已取消，原名額已先釋放。",
          channel: "教學示意通道",
          status: "教學示意未發送",
          createdAt: nowISO()
        });

        if (registration.ticketKey === "early") {
          reserveForWaitlistHead();
        }

        saveState();
        render();
      }

      function simulateCancel() {
        const registration = getActiveRegistration();
        if (!registration) return;

        const shouldRelease = ["pending_payment", "paid", "confirmed"].includes(registration.status);

        if (shouldRelease) {
          releaseSeat(registration);
        }

        registration.status = "cancelled";
        registration.paymentStatus = "cancelled";

        const payment = state.payments.find(p => p.registrationId === registration.id);
        if (payment) {
          payment.result = "已取消（教學模擬）";
        }

        state.notifications.unshift({
          id: uid("notice"),
          target: registration.name,
          content:
            "報名已切換為取消狀態。本原型沒有真實扣款，因此也沒有真實退款。",
          channel: "教學示意通道",
          status: "教學示意未發送",
          createdAt: nowISO()
        });

        if (registration.ticketKey === "early") {
          reserveForWaitlistHead();
        }

        saveState();
        render();
      }

      function renderTickets() {
        const remaining = Math.max(0, Number(state.tickets.early || 0));
        const soldOut = remaining === 0;

        $("#earlySeatText").textContent = `剩餘名額：${remaining} / 10`;
        $("#heroSeatTitle").textContent = remaining === 1 ? "早鳥票只剩 1 名" : (soldOut ? "早鳥票已額滿" : `早鳥票剩餘 ${remaining} 名`);
        $("#heroSeatText").textContent = `剩餘 ${remaining} / 10`;
        $("#heroMeter").style.width = `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (10 - remaining) / 10 * 100))}%`;

        $$(".ticket").forEach(card => {
          card.classList.toggle("active", card.dataset.ticketCard === state.selectedTicket);
        });

        const earlyCard = $('[data-ticket-card="early"]');
        const earlyButton = earlyCard.querySelector(".ticket-select");
        const waitButton = earlyCard.querySelector(".waitlist-open");

        earlyCard.classList.toggle("sold-out", soldOut);
        earlyButton.disabled = soldOut;
        earlyButton.textContent = soldOut ? "已售完" : "選擇早鳥票";
        waitButton.hidden = !soldOut;

        const formTicket = $("#ticket").value;
        const selected = ticketCatalog[formTicket];
        $("#summaryTicket").textContent = selected.name;
        $("#summaryPrice").textContent = money(selected.price);
        $("#summarySeats").textContent = `${Math.max(0, state.tickets[formTicket])} 名`;

        const submit = $("#registrationSubmit");
        const formWait = $("#formWaitlistButton");

        if (formTicket === "early" && state.tickets.early <= 0) {
          submit.disabled = true;
          submit.textContent = "早鳥票已售完";
          formWait.hidden = false;
        } else if (state.tickets[formTicket] <= 0) {
          submit.disabled = true;
          submit.textContent = "此票種已售完";
          formWait.hidden = true;
        } else {
          submit.disabled = false;
          submit.textContent = "送出報名，先取得待付款名額";
          formWait.hidden = true;
        }

        const waitlistSubmit = $("#waitlistSubmit");
        waitlistSubmit.disabled = !soldOut;
        waitlistSubmit.textContent = soldOut
          ? "加入候補"
          : "目前仍有早鳥名額";
      }

      function renderRegistration() {
        const active = getActiveRegistration();
        const latest = state.registrations[state.registrations.length - 1] || null;

        const target = active || latest;

        if (!target) {
          $("#registrationBadge").className = "status-badge";
          $("#registrationBadge").textContent = "尚未報名";
          $("#registrationTitle").textContent = "目前沒有進行中的報名";
          $("#registrationDescription").textContent =
            "填寫下方表單後，成功取得名額的第一筆會先進入「待付款」。";
          $("#summaryPayment").textContent = "尚未建立";
          $("#summaryCheckin").textContent = "未報到";
        } else {
          const status = registrationStatusLabel(target.status);
          $("#registrationBadge").textContent = status;
          $("#registrationTitle").textContent =
            `${target.name}｜${target.ticketName}`;

          let description = "目前為教學模擬狀態。";

          if (target.status === "pending_payment") {
            description = "名額已暫時保留，但尚未完成付款。";
          } else if (target.status === "paid") {
            description = "付款結果已切換為成功，等待確認。";
          } else if (target.status === "confirmed") {
            description = "報名已確認。";
          } else if (target.status === "payment_timeout") {
            description = "付款已逾時，原名額已依規則釋放。";
          } else if (target.status === "cancelled") {
            description = target.cancelReason === "payment_timeout" ? "付款逾時後已取消，名額已釋放。" : "報名已取消。";
          }

          $("#registrationDescription").textContent = description;
          $("#summaryPayment").textContent = paymentStatusLabel(target.paymentStatus);
          $("#summaryCheckin").textContent = target.checkinStatus;

          $("#registrationBadge").className =
            "status-badge " +
            (["paid", "confirmed"].includes(target.status)
              ? "success"
              : ["payment_timeout", "cancelled"].includes(target.status)
              ? "danger"
              : "");
        }

        $$(".step").forEach(step => step.classList.remove("current"));

        if (target) {
          if (target.status === "pending_payment") {
            $('[data-step="pending"]').classList.add("current");
          }
          if (target.status === "paid") {
            $('[data-step="paid"]').classList.add("current");
          }
          if (target.status === "confirmed") {
            $('[data-step="confirmed"]').classList.add("current");
          }
        }

        $("#simulatePaid").disabled = !(active && active.status === "pending_payment");
        $("#simulateTimeout").disabled = !(active && active.status === "pending_payment");
        $("#simulateConfirm").disabled = !(active && active.status === "paid");
        $("#simulateCancel").disabled = !active;
      }

      function renderWaitlist() {
        const activeItems = state.waitlist
          .filter(item => ["waiting", "reserved"].includes(item.status))
          .sort((a, b) => a.rank - b.rank);

        const queue = $("#queueList");

        if (!activeItems.length) {
          queue.innerHTML = '<p class="muted">目前沒有人候補。</p>';
        } else {
          queue.innerHTML = activeItems.map((item, index) => {
            const status = item.status === "reserved"
              ? `名額保留至 ${formatTime(item.reservedUntil)}`
              : "等待名額釋出";

            return `
              <div class="queue-item">
                <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px">
                  <span class="queue-rank">${index + 1}</span>
                  <div>
                    <strong>${escapeHTML(item.name)}</strong><br>
                    <span class="note">${escapeHTML(status)}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            `;
          }).join("");
        }
      }

      function renderNotifications() {
        const latest = state.notifications[0];

        if (!latest) {
          $("#latestNotification").innerHTML =
            "<strong>通知紀錄</strong>尚無通知。所有通知皆僅示意未發送。";
          $("#notificationLog").innerHTML = "<li>尚無通知紀錄。</li>";
          return;
        }

        $("#latestNotification").innerHTML = `
          <strong>${escapeHTML(latest.status)}</strong>
          ${escapeHTML(latest.content)}
        `;

        $("#notificationLog").innerHTML = state.notifications.map(n => `
          <li>
            <strong>${escapeHTML(n.target)}｜${escapeHTML(n.status)}</strong>
            <div>${escapeHTML(n.content)}</div>
            <span class="log-time">
              ${formatTime(n.createdAt)}｜${escapeHTML(n.channel)}
            </span>
          </li>
        `).join("");
      }

      function renderTables() {
        $("#staticDataTable").innerHTML = `
          <tr>
            <td>Event</td>
            <td>event-workshop-20261114</td>
            <td>活動名稱、日期、地點、主辦單位、活動狀態</td>
            <td>品牌策略工作坊｜2026/11/14｜教學示意場地｜教學示例工作室｜開放報名</td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <td>EventSession</td>
            <td>session-main</td>
            <td>場次、開始時間、結束時間、容量</td>
            <td>單日場次｜09:30｜17:00｜示例容量 38</td>
          </tr>
          ${Object.entries(ticketCatalog).map(([key,t]) => `
            <tr>
              <td>TicketType</td>
              <td>${escapeHTML(t.id)}</td>
              <td>票種、價格、開賣、截止、名額</td>
              <td>
                ${escapeHTML(t.name)}｜
                ${money(t.price)}｜
                ${formatTime(t.salesStart)} →
                ${formatTime(t.salesEnd)}｜
                剩餘 ${Math.max(0,state.tickets[key])} / ${t.capacity}
              </td>
            </tr>
          `).join("")}
        `;

        if (!state.registrations.length) {
          $("#registrationTable").innerHTML =
            '<tr><td colspan="5">尚無報名資料。</td></tr>';
        } else {
          $("#registrationTable").innerHTML = state.registrations.map(r => {
            const payment = state.payments.find(p => p.registrationId === r.id);
            const paymentText = payment
              ? `${money(payment.amount)}｜${escapeHTML(payment.method)}｜${escapeHTML(payment.result)}｜${formatTime(payment.transactionTime)}`
              : "—";

            return `
              <tr>
                <td>${escapeHTML(r.name)}</td>
                <td>${escapeHTML(r.ticketName)}</td>
                <td>${escapeHTML(paymentStatusLabel(r.paymentStatus))}</td>
                <td>${escapeHTML(r.checkinStatus)}</td>
                <td>${paymentText}</td>
              </tr>
            `;
          }).join("");
        }

        if (!state.waitlist.length) {
          $("#waitlistTable").innerHTML =
            '<tr><td colspan="4">尚無候補資料。</td></tr>';
        } else {
          $("#waitlistTable").innerHTML = state.waitlist.map((w,index) => `
            <tr>
              <td>${index + 1}</td>
              <td>${escapeHTML(w.name)}</td>
              <td>${formatTime(w.notificationTime)}</td>
              <td>${formatTime(w.reservedUntil)}</td>
            </tr>
          `).join("");
        }

        if (!state.consents.length) {
          $("#consentTable").innerHTML =
            '<tr><td colspan="5">尚無同意紀錄。</td></tr>';
        } else {
          $("#consentTable").innerHTML = state.consents.map(c => `
            <tr>
              <td>${escapeHTML(c.target)}</td>
              <td>${escapeHTML(c.purpose)}</td>
              <td>${formatTime(c.consentTime)}</td>
              <td>${c.marketingConsent ? "同意" : "未同意"}</td>
              <td>${escapeHTML(c.withdrawalMethod)}</td>
            </tr>
          `).join("");
        }
      }

      function render() {
        /*
          無論 localStorage 中資料為何，都強制把剩餘名額限制在 0～capacity，
          避免任何教學操作導致負庫存。
        */
        Object.entries(ticketCatalog).forEach(([key,ticket]) => {
          const value = Number(state.tickets[key] ?? ticket.initialRemaining);
          state.tickets[key] = Math.max(0, Math.min(ticket.capacity, value));
        });

        saveState();
        renderTickets();
        renderRegistration();
        renderWaitlist();
        renderNotifications();
        renderTables();
      }

      $$(".ticket-select").forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener("click", () => setSelectedTicket(button.dataset.ticket));
      });

      $$(".waitlist-open").forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener("click", () => {
          document.querySelector("#waitlist").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
          setTimeout(() => $("#waitlistName").focus(), 450);
        });
      });

      $("#ticket").addEventListener("change", (event) => {
        state.selectedTicket = event.target.value;
        saveState();
        render();
      });

      $("#registrationForm").addEventListener("submit", addRegistration);
      $("#waitlistForm").addEventListener("submit", addWaitlist);

      $("#formWaitlistButton").addEventListener("click", () => {
        const name = $("#name").value.trim();
        const contact = $("#contact").value.trim();

        if (name) $("#waitlistName").value = name;
        if (contact) $("#waitlistContact").value = contact;

        document.querySelector("#waitlist").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
      });

      $("#simulatePaid").addEventListener("click", simulatePaid);
      $("#simulateTimeout").addEventListener("click", simulateTimeout);
      $("#simulateConfirm").addEventListener("click", simulateConfirm);
      $("#simulateCancel").addEventListener("click", simulateCancel);

      $("#resetData").addEventListener("click", () => {
        const confirmed = window.confirm(
          "確定要清除本頁所有教學測試資料，並把早鳥票恢復成剩餘 1 名嗎？"
        );

        if (!confirmed) return;

        state = defaultState();
        localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        saveState();

        $("#registrationForm").reset();
        $("#waitlistForm").reset();
        $("#ticket").value = "early";
        $("#formValidation").textContent = "";
        $("#waitlistValidation").textContent = "";

        render();
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
      });

      $("#ticket").value = state.selectedTicket || "early";
      render();
    })();
  </script>

  <script>
    (function () {
      function labelRows() {
        document.querySelectorAll('table').forEach(function (table) {
          var labels = Array.from(table.querySelectorAll('thead th')).map(function (th) {
            return th.textContent.trim();
          });

          table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').forEach(function (row) {
            Array.from(row.cells).forEach(function (cell, i) {
              if (labels[i]) cell.setAttribute('data-label', labels[i]);
            });
          });
        });
      }

      labelRows();

      new MutationObserver(labelRows).observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true
      });
    })();
  </script>

  <script>(()=>{const ids=['your-title','your-detail','your-boundary'];const defaults=["你的活動，從這裡開始", "日期與時間，由你填入。", "真實規則，先說清楚。"];ids.forEach((id,i)=>{const input=document.getElementById('your-'+i);input.addEventListener('input',()=>{document.getElementById(id).textContent=input.value.trim()||defaults[i]})})})();</script>
<section class="textbook-block" id="addonModel"><h2>同一筆報名的加購品項</h2><p>講義、課後小組、照片包可個別定價。資料模型要能掛多筆品項到同一筆報名。</p></section>
<section class="textbook-block" id="notificationChecks"><h2>通知紀錄的核對欄位</h2><p>NotificationLog：對象、通道、發送時間、是否送達。</p><p>原型紀錄為教學示意未發送；正式通知服務須查 Email、簡訊、LINE 的發送紀錄與失敗重送。</p></section>
<section class="textbook-block" id="textbookChecks"><h2>退款與報到檢查</h2><details id="refund-check"><summary>退款與取消</summary><p>報名狀態、付款狀態、票種庫存必須一起更新；付款逾時、取消、退款與報到狀態分開核對。</p></details><details id="checkin-check"><summary>現場報到</summary><p>名單匯出、核銷、避免重複報到。這是正式上線前要逐項取得證據的檢查。</p></details></section></body>
</html>

    :root {

    a {

      font-weight: 800;
    }

    }

    .state-layout {
      display: grid;

    .steps {

    }

    form.card,
    .summary-card {
      padding: 44px;
    }

    .fields {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));

    }

    .field {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .field.full {

    }

    label,

      font-size: 18px;
